newsitem.title: FRANCE: MAS drops ex-France cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: MAS drops ex-France cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: PARIS, April 17 Reuter) - Malaysian Air System Bhd Paris cargo station said it had dropped its fuel surcharge from April 15.
"This follows a directive to this effect from our central cargo office in London to MAS cargo stations in Europe, a Paris/CDG MAS' official told Reuters.
The Malaysian carrier operates a Boeing 747 three-times weekly Boeing 747 passenger service between Paris and Kuala Lumpur service replacing them with 747 PAX aircraft.
MAS also has an allocation of offline freighter and maindeck capacity offered jointly by the Malaysian carrier and KLM from Schiphol. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
